Hi Connections,

Kanak here. I’m currently exploring Executive Assistant opportunities in Gurgaon and would be grateful for your support and referrals.

I bring 4 years of professional experience as an Executive Assistant, with strong expertise in C-suite support, calendar & travel management, stakeholder coordination, confidential matters, meeting management, internal communication, and end-to-end executive operations.

I’m particularly interested in opportunities where I can leverage my experience, professionalism, and proactive approach to deliver high-level executive support.

If you’re aware of any relevant openings or can connect me with the right hiring professionals, I would truly appreciate your support.

Thank you in advance for your referrals and connections!

Best regards,
Kanak
please connect on-7303104774
comment: For executive support roles, beyond task management, the real differentiator is often anticipating decisions before they happen. Strong EAs create leverage by understanding priorities, not just managing schedules.
